{{Quote|The Gorinth Brig holds people who are inconvenient, not damned.|Carsiri|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gorinth Brig''', originally known as '''Cave 52''' and '''Amber Cavern''', was a detention facility of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located in the [[Gorinth Canyon]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The cave was a resistance stronghold, but when the Empire took it over, they demolished most of the cave system and rebuilt it as a detention facility.
